sentences.en: Leonardo da Vinci desecrated graves in order to study anatomy.
sentences.zh: 莱昂纳多·达·芬奇为了研究解剖学而盗掘坟墓。

sentences.en: "You don't need legs to sit." "Learn some anatomy."
sentences.zh: "你坐着就不需要腿了。" "学点解剖学吧。"

sentences.en: Teachers dissect frogs to teach students their anatomy.
sentences.zh: 老师 dissect 蛙来教学生它们的解剖结构。

senses.zh: 解剖, 解剖学 - (生物体的)解剖结构 - (详细的)分析 - 人体；骨骼；干尸
